WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb) = 'array'
        THEN $1::jsonb -> 0
      ELSE $1::jsonb
    END AS d
),

inserted_order AS (
  INSERT INTO public.orders (
    order_code,
    customer_name,
    customer_phone,
    moderator_name,
    fulfillment_method,
    city,
    area,
    address_details,
    delivery_date,
    delivery_time_from,
    delivery_time_to,
    cake_type,
    cake_size,
    dimensions,
    number_of_tiers,
    filling,
    covering,
    details,
    base_price_egp,
    cake_design_extra_egp,
    addons_total_egp,
    delivery_fee_egp,
    discount_type,
    discount_input_value,
    discount_amount_egp,
    total_order_egp,
    deposit_egp,
    remaining_egp,
    order_summary,
    order_status,
    submitted_at
  )

  SELECT
    d->>'orderCode',
    d->>'name',
    d->>'phone',
    NULLIF(d->>'moderatorName', ''),
    d->>'fulfillmentMethod',
    NULLIF(d->>'city', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'area', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'addressDetails', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'deliveryDate', '')::date,
    NULLIF(d->>'deliveryTimeFrom', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'deliveryTimeTo', ''),
    d->>'cakeType',
    d->>'cakeSize',

    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(d->>'dimensions', '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LEFT(BTRIM(d->>'dimensions'), 1) IN ('{', '[')
        THEN (d->>'dimensions')::jsonb
      ELSE to_jsonb(d->>'dimensions')
    END,

    NULLIF(d->>'numberOfTiers', '')::integer,
    NULLIF(d->>'filling', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'covering', ''),
    NULLIF(d->>'details', ''),

    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'basePriceEGP', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'cakeDesignExtraEGP', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'addOnsTotalEGP', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'deliveryFeeEGP', '')::numeric, 0),

    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'discountType', ''), 'none'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'discountInputValue', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'discountAmountEGP', '')::numeric, 0),

    totals.total_amount,
    totals.deposit_amount,
    totals.total_amount - totals.deposit_amount,

    NULLIF(d->>'orderSummary', ''),

    CASE
      WHEN totals.deposit_amount > 0 THEN 'تم التأكيد'
      ELSE 'قيد التأكيد'
    END,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(d->>'submittedAt', '')::timestamptz,
      NOW()
    )

  FROM input

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'totalOrderEGP', '')::numeric, 0)
        AS total_amount,

      COALESCE(NULLIF(d->>'depositEGP', '')::numeric, 0)
        AS deposit_amount
  ) AS totals

  WHERE totals.deposit_amount >= 0
    AND totals.deposit_amount <= totals.total_amount

  RETURNING id, order_code
),

inserted_addons AS (
  INSERT INTO public.order_addons (
    order_id,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit,
    quantity,
    unit_price_egp,
    design_extra_egp,
    total_egp
  )

  SELECT
    o.id,
    addon->>'productId',
    addon->>'productName',
    COALESCE(NULLIF(addon->>'unit', ''), 'unit'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(addon->>'quantity', '')::numeric, 1),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(addon->>'unitPriceEGP', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(addon->>'designExtraEGP', '')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(addon->>'totalEGP', '')::numeric, 0)

  FROM inserted_order o
  CROSS JOIN input i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(i.d->'addOns', '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS addon

  RETURNING id
)

SELECT
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.order_code,
  'success'::text AS status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_addons)::integer AS addons_saved

FROM inserted_order o;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS d
)
INSERT INTO order_images (
  order_id,
  image_type,
  file_name,
  object_key,
  mime_type,
  file_size_bytes,
  is_active,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  (d->>'orderId')::bigint,
  d->>'imageType',
  d->>'fileName',
  d->>'objectKey',
  NULLIF(d->>'mimeType', ''),
  NULLIF(d->>'fileSizeBytes', '')::bigint,
  TRUE,
  NOW()
FROM input
RETURNING id, order_id, image_type, object_key, file_size_bytes;
